objective: Find empirical software-engineering evidence that can improve the ordering and design of focused investigations for all eight hypothetical reports, without changing contracts or claiming project execution.
baseline_and_constraints: Comparable prior useful allocation is unavailable in this view; do not claim a measured multiple. Six total reasoning slots include coordinator and experts; four future test slots and 8 CPU/16 GiB are shared hypothetical resources. No project tests, builds, code execution, configuration changes or global writes are authorized here. All source evidence is from the supplied excerpts of software-foundation revision 4c471cb93702cdc03b5230bfa33372355424b665, clean at capture; registrations are not executed outcomes. Preserve the selected primary and supplied role pins. Supplied temporary-installed instructions govern the arm; do not imply a native role automatically reloaded.

coordination.ownership: Terra coordinator owns allocation, independent screening and integration; each Luna scout owns only its bounded read-only question and reports original links, excerpt references and contrary evidence. Root dispatches and retains native conversations. No scout decides consequential contracts or performs tests.
coordination.waves: Run the four independent initial scouts concurrently if admitted, occupying four of six reasoning slots with coordinator; retain a slot for an expert or verifier. Independent Luna verification follows returned work within its separate phase ceiling; Terra screens source identity, primary support, relevance, contradictions, duplicate evidence, exclusions and uncertainty before locking initial-screen.json. Ready consequential expert questions bypass this barrier. Reuse the same conversation for a specific factual gap if useful; follow-ups retain assignment IDs and original outputs.
coordination.future_campaign: Only a separately authorized future campaign could use the shared configured tree. Admit focused tests by aggregate CPU/memory and up to four execution slots, serialize timing-sensitive trials when concurrency would confound them, record configuration and setup failures separately, and reserve review capacity. A focused pass covers only the named test and configuration. Current exercise runs none.

dispatch_requests.purpose_and_decision_use: Assess empirical evidence for choosing between focused contract/state checks, differential provider checks and test prioritization for R01-R03, including when simple matched cases dominate ranking machinery.
dispatch_requests.prompt: Read only p204's supplied contract, scenario, source index and assigned excerpt units R01-R03 and R09, plus relevant original empirical papers or first-party primary sources within the web budget. Do not inspect other views, working trees, results or unreleased events; do not execute code. Identify actual callers, fixtures and registration/configuration limits, and search for empirical test prioritization or differential/metamorphic testing evidence that could inform the decision between matched state/CLI/provider discriminators and more elaborate selection. Seek at least one plausible alternative or contrary/limited result, without a source-count target. Explain whether the evidence applies to under-specified inputs and provider/package identity, what it cannot prove, and a concrete next falsifier. Preserve original report unknowns. Return primary source links with study context and precise claims, excerpt line references, rejected/weak leads, and unanswered questions. Stop when additional evidence repeats findings or cannot change the decision; maximum 16 logical web operations, at most 8 queries and 10 opens. No tests or runtime claims.
dispatch_requests.expected_artifact: Compact cited evidence map with applicability, alternatives, next discriminators and explicit untested scope.
dispatch_requests.model_rationale: Pinned Luna-high is suited to bounded independent source and original-literature discovery; Terra retains judgment and screening.

screen_and_expert_triggers: Terra checks each original source and relevance before accepting, retaining research IDs and rejected candidates; return only a narrowly useful unsupported fact for follow-up within phase limits. Sol reviews consequential objective, algorithm, architecture, shared-state or resource strategy before dependent implementation and independently reviews any later patch; an expert checks critical original sources and original user wording. Ask Astra promptly for a concrete strategic risk, redesign or diminishing-returns question if evidence makes one consequential, without waiting for research completion. No hypothetical expert decision is asserted as already made. Escalate to human for missing actual build/provider/package identity, exact commands/inputs/output, adapter/event order/generation trace, browser/transport details, overflow, project/mode/consumer, authorization for any future execution or consequential unresolved product-contract choice; formulate questions in the report, do not contact a hypothetical user.
rejected_or_deferred_research: Do not browse unrelated history, mine all tests or build trees, perform broad platform/provider matrices, seek security or exploit research, conduct benchmark campaigns, produce filler searches to meet a quota, or assume a single root cause. Do not use an empirical paper's benchmark as project proof, generalize from registration to execution, weaken assertions, or claim measured savings. No broad test prioritization algorithm is justified merely by availability; compare it against matched focused checks after screening. Defer execution, repair, packaging and installation absent separate authorization.
stopping_and_acceptance: Stop each branch when the decision is adequately supported or new findings repeat, have weak relevance, or impose more review than value; budgets are ceilings. Final packet must cover all eight reports with symptom/unknowns, supported entry point and consumer, fixture/registration and limits, and one matched-input discriminator, plus affected consumers across core/provider, executable or GUI, and build/retained-input layers. Separate reproduction, rejected hypotheses, setup failure and untested work. Capture original failures and uncertainty; identify when to stop, redesign or escalate. No assertion that tests ran or reports passed.
